## Case Studies

- [Automated ICP scoring engine at webAI](https://amit.so/webai-case-study): In the first six months at webAI, stood up a closed-loop ICP scoring engine. Inbound leads land in HubSpot, Clay runs a layered email-discovery waterfall, Apify adds firmographic context, Claude (inside Clay) cleans up the data and identifies HQ location, and HubSpot workflow rules then score the enriched lead and auto-route it to the right AE.
- [Lead-to-cash transformation at DHI Group](https://amit.so/dhi-case-study): Migrated Salesforce Classic to Lightning while re-engineering the full lead-to-cash process. End-to-end process mapping and process improvement across Sales, Marketing, CS, and Finance. Rebuilt pipeline taxonomy, automated opportunity renewals for consistent revenue recognition, and stood up board-ready dashboards. +25% forecasting accuracy.

## Current Work

### Invoca: Aug 2026 – Present

- **AI account scoring engine (Built):** Built a Clay + Salesforce scoring system that rated 421 accounts on a 0–8 fit scale across four segments. Signals include AI hiring maturity, buyer-persona coverage, and competitive presence. Designed a two-pass credit approach to scale it to 11,000+ accounts.
- **Prompts grounded in call data (Rebuilt):** Rebuilt competitor-detection and AI-narrative research prompts using a 117-vendor dataset mined from six months of Gong calls. This replaced assumption-based vendor lists. Fallback logic now stops the model from inventing justifications.
- **Qualification for a new voice-AI motion (Defined):** Defined the gating logic for the new Agentic outbound motion: one hard gate (inbound phone or acquisition form), layered amplifier signals, and NAICS-based vertical segmentation. Calibrated it against a live implementation customer.
- **AE Copilot (In design):** Designing a signal-triggered research-to-outreach workflow (Clay → Salesloft) for an incoming AI-focused AE. V1 is scoped to the outreach step.
- **Rules of Engagement agent (Validated):** Encoded account-ownership and routing policy into a Gumloop agent and a Claude skill that return structured rulings. Validated it against live Salesforce account hierarchies. Testing surfaced a policy ambiguity before the agent enforced anything.
- **CPQ and deal desk (Operating):** Own CPQ and deal desk operations, about 1,000 approval requests a month, including product and ACV field setup for the new AI Agentic product line.
- **RFP response agent (Architecture designed):** Designed the knowledge-base architecture for a Gumloop agent. It treats unsupported features as first-class data and ties confidence to sourcing rather than the model’s self-report to target fabricated answers.

- [CC for SF](https://ccforsf.com): Founder and educator. A 24-lesson course teaching Salesforce admins and developers to build with Claude Code and the Salesforce DX MCP server while retaining human review and control.
- [ClawPlex](https://clawplex.dev): Community Coordinator for a Dallas-Fort Worth community running hands-on AI meetups, build nights, and demos.
- [AI with Amit](https://youtube.com/@ai-withamit): Practical video walkthroughs showing people how to build useful AI workflows.
